edges.reason: Mining leaves with shears demonstrates tool proficiency needed before attempting the more complex golden_axe craft on the crafting table
Crafting melon_seeds first as a simpler recipe builds familiarity with crafting UI before the 3x3 golden_axe recipe

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has to check that the player has obtained spruce_leaves in their inventory. Mining spruce leaves with shears drops the leaf block as an item, which ends up in the player's inventory. This is the most direct check for a mining task. The player starts with shears but no spruce_leaves, so finding spruce_leaves in inventory confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has to check that the player has crafted melon_seeds. The recipe is 1 melon_slice → 1 melon_seeds (works in 2x2 inventory grid). The player starts with melon slices but no melon seeds, so finding melon_seeds in inventory confirms the craft was completed. inventory_has is preferred because the crafted item ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has to check that the player has crafted a golden_axe. The recipe requires 3 gold ingots and 2 sticks arranged in the 3x3 crafting table grid. The player starts with exactly these materials and a nearby crafting table but no golden_axe, so finding golden_axe in inventory confirms successful crafting. inventory_has is the preferred rule for craft tasks.

scene_description: A cleared grass platform with a small spruce tree (2 logs + 10 leaves) and a crafting table. The player spawns with melon slices, gold ingots, sticks, and shears in their hotbar. The scene supports three tasks: mining spruce leaves with shears, crafting melon seeds from melon slices, and crafting a golden axe from gold ingots and sticks on the crafting table.
task_text: Mine spruce leaves using shears, craft melon seeds from melon slices, then craft a golden axe using the crafting table with gold ingots and sticks.
design_notes: The grass platform is 11x11 blocks centered on spawn. Air fill clears natural vegetation to make placed elements visible. The spruce tree is 3 blocks east of spawn with 2 logs (y+1, y+2) and 10 leaves at y+3 and y+4 forming a small canopy. The crafting table is 4 blocks north of spawn at ground level. Player inventory provides exactly the materials needed: shears for mining leaves, 2 melon slices for melon_seeds craft (only 1 needed), 3 gold ingots + 2 sticks for golden_axe craft. Melon seeds can be crafted in the 2x2 inventory grid; golden_axe requires the 3x3 crafting table.
